key.name: favorite-emojis
key.description: List of favorite emojis (up to 50) displayed in the popup.

key.name: nbcols
key.description: Sets the number of columns of emojis to display.

key.name: emojisize
key.description: Default size of emojis in pixels in the popup menu.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: If true, pressing Copy or Ctrl+Enter will attempt to paste into the focused window.

key.description: If true, Super+Period will toggle the popup menu.

key.name: always-show
key.description: If false, the top panel indicator icon will be hidden.

key.name: emoji-keybind
